titleEn: How Much Does a Condo Renovation Cost in Metro Vancouver 2026?
titleZh: 大溫哥華公寓裝修造價 2026：各城實支實算
contentEn:
Metro Vancouver condo renovation costs in 2026 range from $14,000 to $90,000 or more, depending entirely on scope. Most owners spend $16,000 to $50,000. Reno Stars has tracked actual project costs across Richmond, Burnaby, North Vancouver, Coquitlam, and Vancouver for three years — here is what the numbers actually look like.

See real condo renovation projects across Metro Vancouver: Richmond condo flooring replacement, Coquitlam condo kitchen with quartz countertops, and a budget-friendly Richmond condo refresh.

Condo Renovation Cost Ranges in Metro Vancouver 2026

Every condo renovation falls into one of four cost tiers. The tier determines your budget before you talk to a contractor. These are all 2026 figures from Reno Stars projects across Metro Vancouver.

Renovation ScopeTypical Cost RangeWhat It Includes
Cosmetic refresh$14,000 – $22,000Paint, LVP flooring, cabinet refacing, new fixtures, wallpaper removal
Standard update$22,000 – $38,000New cabinetry, quartz countertops, bathroom refresh, flooring, lighting
Comprehensive renovation$38,000 – $55,000Layout changes, new bathroom, kitchen with island, full tile work
Full custom luxury$55,000 – $90,000+Custom millwork, structural changes, high-end appliances, premium stone

What Actually Drives Condo Renovation Cost Up

Four factors determine where your project lands on the cost scale. Understanding them before you get a quote prevents budget surprises mid-project.

Layout changes. Moving walls, reorienting the kitchen, or combining bathrooms requires a structural engineer and City of Vancouver building permit. Each structural change adds $5,000 to $15,000 to your project. A cosmetic refresh with no layout changes stays at the lower end of your tier.

Plumbing and electrical upgrades. Moving a sink, adding a gas line, or upgrading from 60-amp to 100-amp electrical service requires a licensed plumber or electrician, a permit, and inspection. Each trade add averages $3,000 to $8,000. Keeping fixtures in their current locations controls cost.

Material specifications. Custom cabinetry runs $18,000 to $35,000 for a full kitchen. Semi-custom equivalents start at $12,000. The same logic applies to stone: quartz at $60–$120 per square foot installed versus marble at $120–$250. Condos with existing quality finishes only need targeted upgrades rather than full replacement.

Strata and logistics. Most Metro Vancouver condos require strata council approval before work begins. The approval process takes 2–4 weeks on top of your project timeline. High-rise condos add elevator booking fees, freight costs, and restricted work hours — all legitimate line items that belong in your budget.

Richmond kitchen renovations in the $16,000–$28,000 range represent the highest volume of Reno Stars condo projects — reflecting the city's large strata condo stock and the preference among Richmond's Chinese-Canadian community for premium finishes that command higher resale values.

Most Condos Need Strata Approval — Here Is How That Works

In Metro Vancouver, the majority of condo and townhouse complexes are governed by a strata corporation. Strata approval is a separate process from your City building permit, and it runs in parallel. Here is what is required.

A complete strata submission package includes: a detailed scope of work description, proof of contractor's $5M commercial general liability (CGL) insurance, Workers' Compensation Board (WCB) confirmation, a damage deposit (typically $500–$2,000, refunded after project completion), and sometimes floor plan drawings or material specifications. Most strata councils return approvals within 2–4 weeks of receiving a complete package. Reno Stars prepares and submits the full package on every project — the owner provides signatures, we handle the rest.

Richmond stratas are notably bilingual in their correspondence — Reno Stars' Mandarin-speaking project managers coordinate directly with property managers and strata councils in both English and Chinese, eliminating translation delays that can extend approval timelines.

What Does a Full Condo Kitchen Renovation Include?

A complete condo kitchen renovation at the mid-range level ($22,000–$38,000) includes: new semi-custom shaker cabinetry, quartz or granite countertops, a tiled backsplash, updated sink and faucet, new lighting (pot lights and under-cabinet LED), new LVP or tile flooring, and any electrical upgrades needed for new appliances. All demolition, debris removal, and site protection are included. This is the scope Reno Stars completes most frequently in Metro Vancouver condos.

At the budget end ($14,000–$22,000), a kitchen refresh keeps existing cabinet boxes and doors, replaces the countertop with quartz, adds a new faucet and sink, and includes fresh paint and updated lighting. The result is a near-complete visual transformation at a fraction of the full-renovation cost — and the highest ROI renovation for pre-sale sellers in competitive condo markets.

Lisa Jung, a Burnaby condo owner, worked with Reno Stars on a kitchen refresh: "This is our second project with Reno Stars, and once again the experience was excellent. Sylvia, Ryan, and Jasper make a fantastic team, the workmanship was great, everything stayed on budget, and communication was always quick and easy."

What is the cheapest way to renovate a condo in Vancouver?

A cosmetic refresh at $14,000–$22,000 is the most cost-effective renovation for a Vancouver condo. It includes fresh paint, new LVP flooring, cabinet refacing or new doors, updated fixtures, and lighting replacement. A cosmetic refresh achieves a near-complete visual transformation without the cost of new cabinetry or layout changes — and it is the fastest timeline, typically completing in 2–3 weeks.

How long does strata approval take for a condo renovation in Vancouver?

Most Vancouver strata councils return approval within 2–4 weeks of receiving a complete submission package. The package requires your contractor's $5M CGL insurance certificate, WCB confirmation, a detailed scope description, and a damage deposit. Incomplete packages are the primary cause of delays — Reno Stars prepares complete packages on every project. Complex buildings with older bylaws or contentious strata councils may extend to 6 weeks. Richmond strata councils frequently approve within 2 weeks given high renovation volume in that city.

What is the average cost of a condo renovation in Metro Vancouver?

The average Metro Vancouver condo renovation in 2026 costs $22,000–$38,000 for a standard mid-range update (new cabinetry, quartz countertops, updated bathroom, new flooring). Budget cosmetic refreshes start at $14,000. Full custom luxury renovations with structural changes, premium appliances, and custom millwork reach $55,000–$90,000+. Most owners spend in the $22,000–$44,000 range. The specific city, building type, and scope of work determine where any individual project lands within that range.

Does a condo renovation add value to the unit?

Yes — strategically. In competitive Metro Vancouver condo markets, updated kitchens and bathrooms consistently command 3–8% price premiums over unrenovated comparable units. A $22,000 kitchen refresh in Richmond's condo market generates an estimated $30,000–$55,000 in additional sale value in the current market. Burnaby Metrotown buyers — many of whom are Chinese-Canadian families prioritising kitchen quality — price unrenovated kitchens at a significant mental discount. Reno Stars tracks actual resale outcomes on every completed project.

2026年，大溫哥華公寓裝修造價從14,000元到90,000元以上不等，取決於工程範圍。多數業主預算在16,000至50,000元之間。聚星裝修三年來追蹤列治文、本拿比、北溫、滿橋港及溫哥華實際工程造價——以下是真實數據。

可見大溫哥華公寓裝修實例：列治文公寓地板更換、滿橋港石英石枱面公寓廚房、經濟實惠型列治文公寓翻新。

大溫哥華公寓裝修造價範圍 2026

每個公寓裝修項目都屬於四個造價等級之一。等級在您聯繫承包商之前就決定了預算。以下均為聚星裝修大溫哥華各城市的2026年實際項目數據。

裝修範圍典型造價範圍包含項目
基本翻新$14,000 – $22,000油漆、LVP地板、櫥櫃面板更新、衛浴設備更新、牆紙清除
標準更新$22,000 – $38,000新櫥櫃、石英石枱面、浴室更新、地板、照明
全面裝修$38,000 – $55,000佈局更改、新浴室、配中島廚房、瓷磚工程
豪華定制$55,000 – $90,000+定制細木工、結構更改、高端電器、優質石材

什麼因素實際推高公寓裝修成本

四個因素決定項目落在哪個造價等級。報價前了解這些因素，可防止預算中途超支。

佈局更改。移動牆壁、重新調整廚房佈局或合併浴室，需要結構工程師和溫哥華市建築許可。每項結構更改增加5,000至15,000元。基本翻新不改動佈局，造價控制在各等級低位。

管道和電氣升級。移動洗手盆、增加煤氣管道或將60安電錶升級至100安，需要持牌水管工或電工、許可證及驗收。每次額外工序平均增加3,000至8,000元。保持設備位置不變可控制成本。

材料規格。全屋定制櫥櫃造價18,000至35,000元。半定制替代品起價12,000元。石材同樣：已安裝石英石每平方呎60至120元，而大理石則為120至250元。現有房屋已有優質裝修的公寓，僅需有針對性的升級，無需全面更換。

物業條例及物流。大多數大溫哥華公寓需要在工程開始前獲得業主立案法團批准。審批流程需時2至4週，計入項目時間。高層公寓產生電梯預訂費、貨運費及受限工作時段——這些都是預算中的合理項目。

大多數公寓需要業主立案法團批准——運作方式

在大溫哥華，大多數公寓和城市屋都由業主立案法團管理。立案法團批准是與市建築許可證分開的流程，兩者並行。以下是所需內容。

完整的立案法團申請包包括：詳細工程範圍說明、承包商500萬元商業一般責任保險（CGL）證明、勞工補償局（WCB）確認、保證金（通常500至2,000元，項目完成後退還），有時還需要平面圖或材料規格。大多數立案法團在收到完整申請包後2至4週內給出批准。聚星裝修在每個項目中都準備並提交完整申請包——業主只需簽名，其餘由我們處理。

溫哥華公寓裝修最省錢的方式是什麼？

14,000至22,000元的基本翻新是溫哥華公寓最具成本效益的裝修方案。包括新鮮油漆、新LVP地板、櫥櫃面板更新、更新設備和照明更換。基本翻新實現接近完全的視覺改造，無需新櫥櫃或佈局更改的成本——而且是最短工期，通常2至3週完成。

溫哥華公寓裝修的立案法團批准需要多長時間？

大多數溫哥華立案法團在收到完整申請包後2至4週內給出批准。申請包需要承包商的500萬元CGL保險證明、WCB確認、詳細範圍說明和保證金。不完整申請包是延遲的主要原因——聚星裝修在每個項目中準備完整申請包。章程較舊或較具爭議的立案法團可能延長至6週。列治文立案法團由於該市裝修量大，通常在2週內批准。

大溫哥華公寓裝修的平均成本是多少？

2026年大溫哥華公寓裝修平均成本為22,000至38,000元，用於標準中檔更新（新櫥櫃、石英石枱面、更新浴室、新地板）。經濟基本翻新起價14,000元。包含結構更改、高端電器和定制細木工的豪華定制可達55,000至90,000元以上。大多數業主花費在22,000至44,000元之間。具體城市、建築類型和工程範圍決定每個項目落在該範圍內的哪個位置。
